events.name: Inauguration
events.description: ACE held the inauguration ceremony for the year 2019-2020 on 8th August 2019, followed by a guest lecture from Mr. Jigar Doshi, co-founder of Cheeni Labs Pvt. Ltd, who was the chief guest. HoD Dr. R. Anitha addressed the gathering, Vice President Adhitya Krish introduced the chief guest, and President Sandhya Rao presented the ACE report for 2018-2019. The event ended with a vote of thanks by Vice President Subhiksha.

events.name: Tech-know Quiz
events.description: ACE organized the Tech-know quiz to recognize and motivate technology-savvy second and third year students. 60 students competed in teams of two across four rounds: a general knowledge round, a logo-guessing round, a connection round (guessing the link between four displayed pictures), and a final long-connect round. Winners were decided on cumulative performance across all rounds.
events.requirements: Four rounds: general quiz, logo round, connection round, long connect round.

events.name: Interrupt'19
events.description: ACE organized its national-level technical symposium, Interrupt'19, with the entire Computer Science and Engineering department, across all years, helping out as organizers, designers, developers and volunteers. The inaugural function opened with a prayer song by the treasurer and a welcome address by the joint secretary, followed by an address from HoD Dr. R. Anitha. Vice President Subhiksha introduced the chief guest, Ms. Rathna Kamakshi, who lit the lamp and launched the symposium's inaugural video. The valedictory function was held later the same day from 2:45 PM to 3:15 PM, with a welcome address by executive member Ms. Merin Ann Jose, and prizes and certificates distributed to winners by HoD Dr. R. Anitha.

events.name: Game of Tags
events.description: Held prior to the Interrupt'19 symposium, Game of Tags challenged 26 two-member teams to develop a website with the best user interface (UI). The event gave design-inclined students a platform to showcase their talent, with winners decided by a panel of experts' review combined with viewer votes.
events.requirements: Teams of 2 designed a website with the best UI; judged by an expert panel and viewer votes.

events.name: Mindspar
events.description: Mindspar was a technical debate event held as part of Interrupt'19, where participants expressed their technical knowledge and oratory skills to win points.

events.name: Now You C Me
events.description: Now You C Me was a technical event under Interrupt'19 that involved debugging and arranging jumbled-up code to win points for the team.

events.name: Stack Market
events.description: Stack Market was a technical event under Interrupt'19 where participants played to win keywords in the first round, then used the keywords they had bought to code their way through the second round.

events.name: Alt + Tab + Tech
events.description: Alt + Tab + Tech was an Interrupt'19 event where participants had to think up ideas and solutions to the problem statements given to them.

events.name: Interrupt Challenge 2.0
events.description: Interrupt Challenge 2.0 was an event under Interrupt'19 where participants used creative thinking and logical reasoning to find their way through various levels.

events.name: Win-code-ium LeviOsa
events.description: Win-code-ium LeviOsa was a surprise event conducted at Interrupt'19 where a mix of luck and skill mattered. Tasks were chosen based on the participant's luck, and they had to solve or code the solution to it.

events.name: Presentation Nation
events.description: Presentation Nation was a paper presentation event held under Interrupt'19, where the entry with the most creative and feasible idea won.

events.name: Code Connoisseur
events.description: Code Connoisseur was the online mainstream coding event of Interrupt'19, where participants put their extensive coding skills to use to win points.

events.name: Poster Coaster
events.description: Poster Coaster was the poster presentation event of Interrupt'19, where participants presented a creative poster for a chosen idea or problem statement.

events.name: Mini Project
events.description: The Mini Project event, part of Interrupt'19, was conducted for all second and third year students of the CS department at SVCE, who showcased their project work with the help of their mentors.

events.name: Docker Workshop
events.description: ACE held a workshop on Docker for second and third year students, hosted by Mr. Vikkram Anand, an alumnus of the institution currently working at Freshworks. The workshop introduced students to Docker, a trending tool used by companies for developing and deploying applications, and included hands-on sessions where students individually executed basic Docker commands. Doubts and clarifications were addressed at the end of the session.

events.name: Womania
events.description: Womania was conducted in celebration of Women's Day, with 42 women participants from first, second and third years. The first round was a lip-reading guessing game played in pairs using headphones; the top five teams advanced to a Pictionary round in which one player drew a given word while the other guessed it. The event was aimed at boosting team spirit and pride in being a woman.
events.requirements: Round 1: lip-reading word-guessing game in pairs; top 5 teams advance to a Pictionary round.

events.name: Code Bingo
events.description: Code Bingo was a fun coding contest held for first year students, with around 50 students participating. Each student picked a lot for a bingo board of programs to be solved, with a set of compulsory questions followed by additional bonus questions, each carrying a 15-minute time limit. Solved questions were struck off the board, and whoever completed the most rows was declared the winner.
events.requirements: Bingo-board coding challenges (15 minutes per question); complete rows on the board to earn points; most completed rows wins.

events.name: Hackerrupt'20
events.venue: Guvi Geek Network Pvt. Ltd., IITM Research Park, Chennai
events.description: Hackerrupt'20 was ACE's first-ever hackathon, a 24-hour inter-college event held over 14th-15th March 2020. Students registered online through a website built by ACE members, drawing 74 teams from various engineering colleges, of which 20 were shortlisted and 70 participants took part overall. Industry mentors, including alumni and experts from Exeter Premedia Services and Adeptrite Solutions, guided teams and judged their ideas across two rounds; the top 7 teams delivered a final pitch to all participants and judges before winners were announced and participation certificates and goodie bags distributed.
events.prizes: 2nd place: Rs. 8,000 (visible on prize cheque in event photo)
events.requirements: Online registration; ideas judged across two rounds by industry experts; top 7 teams delivered a final pitch.

events.name: Webinar.py
events.description: Webinar.py was an interactive webinar series on Python programming, launched to help students learn Python and use their time effectively during quarantine. Open to first, second and third year students across all departments, it drew over 260 attendees on a live YouTube stream, hosted by fourth-year students Mr. Ajay Athitya and Mr. Kailash along with Business Analyst Mr. Sathvik Manikantan. Students posed questions via live chat, study materials and GitHub links were shared, and each session ended with a mandatory test; certificates were awarded to those who attended and completed all sessions and tests.
events.requirements: Mandatory end-of-session test; certificate awarded for full attendance and completed tests.
